parameters.content:
## DRAFT - THE_ONE actual node structure (Chatbot RAG)
**UNPUBLISHED / NOT CONNECTED TO THE_X APP.**
Model + PostgreSQL Memory + Vector QA Tool + PGVector Store + Gemini Embeddings + second Gemini model.
Before activation: provision a separate THE_X PGVector database, create least-privilege PostgreSQL credentials for memory/retrieval, import reviewed manuals with matching embedding model/dimension, implement Django owner-checked conversation_id and verified citation handoff, test isolation/quality/latency/quota.
No THE_ONE credentials or records copied. No database changes or paid API calls made.
Memory key must be the owner-checked conversation UUID; no execution-id fallback. Metadata is one JSON column (metadata), not comma-separated column names.
Current working app target remains THE_X AI Agent - THE_ONE style. This draft will reject existing app payloads until session integration is completed.
